gaps.explanation: 72 jewel socket slot(s) belong to an equipment item. The engine accepts a jewel there only when the parent item has jewel sockets and, for some items, only certain jewel bases. The probe runs with empty parents, so these slots accept nothing in this profile and imported jewels in them stay unplaced.
